# Boards

<!-- auto-generated by cmd/docgen — do not edit -->

Boards are the visual representations of work in Jira Software. A board can
be Scrum (sprint-based) or Kanban (continuous flow). Board IDs are numeric.

## jira board list

List boards accessible to the current user.

**Alias:** `ls`

### Usage

```
jira board list [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | `-p` | Filter by project key |
| `--type` | | Filter by board type: `scrum` or `kanban` |
| `--limit` | `-L` | Maximum boards to display |

### Inherited Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--context` | `-c` | Active Jira context name |
| `--json` | | Output in JSON format |
| `--yaml` | | Output in YAML format |

### Examples

```bash
jira board list
jira board list --project MYPROJ
jira board list --type scrum --json
```

## jira board view

Display details for a board.

### Usage

```
jira board view <board-id> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--web` | `-w` | Open in browser |

### Examples

```bash
jira board view 42
jira board view 42 --json
jira board view 42 --web
```

---

## jira board issues

List issues on a board (backlog + active sprint).

### Usage

```
jira board issues <board-id> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--backlog` | | Show only backlog issues |
| `--status` | `-s` | Filter by status |
| `--type` | `-T` | Filter by issue type |
| `--assignee` | `-a` | Filter by assignee |
| `--limit` | `-L` | Maximum issues to display |

### Examples

```bash
jira board issues 42
jira board issues 42 --backlog
jira board issues 42 --assignee me --status "To Do"
jira board issues 42 --json | jq '.[].key'
```
